lines.q: Which of the seven ancient wonders is still standing?
lines.a: The Great Pyramid of Giza! The oldest of the seven, and the only survivor.

lines.q: What did winners at the ancient Olympic Games get as their prize?
lines.a: An olive wreath! Medals only came with the modern Games.

lines.q: Who was Britain's longest reigning monarch before Elizabeth the Second?
lines.a: Queen Victoria! Almost sixty four years on the throne.

lines.q: Last one. What is Big Ben, really?
lines.a: The bell! The tower is called the Elizabeth Tower. Think you can get all four? Go again!
